text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Biko Pegasus, 
who hasn't been in top form lately.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Please let me become the strongest hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! Finished praying! Let's head 
back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is that—?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
No no no nooo! I don't want bad luck, 
nooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Even if you say that, there's nothing we 
can do about it. ...Come on, let's head 
back.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer! I'm gonna step out for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hello! Hey, why are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... My fortune was 'Bad Luck'... 
Misfortune is gonna strike me...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see! In that case, I'm gonna draw a 
fortune right now, so let's trade!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Huh... Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because I'm a hero of justice! I'll 
draw an Excellent Luck fortune and save 
you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay! Great blessing! I actually drew 
it!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*... In that case, I bestow my 'Great 
Fortune' upon you! A present from a hero!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Thank you! This means I'll get 
Great Fortune too, right...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Of course! So no more moping around, 
okay? That's a promise to Justice Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, did you see that, Trainer!? I 
really pulled great blessing!
choice_data_list: Yeah. That little girl was so happy!
Yeah. That little girl was so happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh! I only did what any hero would 
do!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, I'm gonna go tie up this bad 
luck fortune! Uooooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having successfully helped someone out, 
Biko Pegasus was back in top form!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wh— It's "Bad Luck"! Dammit all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Come to think of it, I'm in super 
bad shape right now...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry I couldn't be of any help. I 
really wanted to give you an 'Excellent 
Luck,' but..."

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I'm totally fine... I'm fine, 
really... Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the little girl with tears in her 
eyes was led away from the shrine by her 
mother...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I wasn't able to act like a hero 
at all today...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Can someone like me really become a real 
hero...? Uuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus seemed down in the dumps, and 
couldn't quite get her groove back after 
that...
